claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened
claims.evidence: Witness shows the case open in Photo 0, but no clear evidence of repair history or whether it was previously opened beyond that.
Photos show the keyboard/case and keys, but no power-on/test, no screen/LED activity, and no audio output.
No receipt/warranty documents are shown in the witness report.
Brand text is readable on Photo 1.

risks.risk: Not the exact model/spec (only brand text is readable; model number/specs not visible), which affects value and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the full model number/spec label (front/back/bottom) and any model sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/unspecified portable keyboard with limited confirmed features.

risks.risk: Functionality risk: keys may be dead/sticky or some notes may fail even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: A short video of power-on and a full key test (play across all keys) plus showing any LEDs/display responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested (worst-case: may have note/key issues).

risks.risk: Power/connectivity risk: may require a specific adapter/voltage or have missing/failed ports (USB/MIDI/headphone/sustain).
risks.proof: Photos of all ports/connectors and a video showing it running with the correct power source (adapter/battery) and any visible port activity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing power/adapter verification and possible port issues.

risks.risk: Condition risk: hinge/latch, casing cracks, or wear may not be visible from the shown angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of hinges/latch, corners/edges, and any scuffs/cracks on both open and closed views.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition unless casing/hinge/latch are clearly shown perfect.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (adapter, stand, sustain pedal, manual), reducing usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A photo inventory laid out showing every included accessory (adapter, pedal, stand, manual) with labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as keyboard-only (no accessories) until items are confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the full model number/spec label (not just brand).
Video: power-on + play test across all keys (showing LEDs/display if any).
Photos of all ports/connectors and a video confirming it works with the correct power source.
Close-ups of hinges/latch and all corners/edges for cracks or damage.
Photos of included accessories laid out (adapter, sustain pedal, stand, manual) and any warranty/receipt documents.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a HARMAN/KARDON portable keyboard in a hard case, but key specs and—most importantly—working condition (power-on/test) and included accessories are not verifiable from the photos. Proof is needed to price safely in Oyo.
